findings.title: Ordinary counted-work publication incorrectly requires native WorkLease capability
findings.trigger: Ordinary SetSync with a valid Lease-only enrollment of the existing arena metadata owner. All four original cache-refusal children trigger this before their intended late hook.
findings.cause: NewPrimaryConstructionTransactionV6 passes native=false, but its shared constructor unconditionally dispatches AddPendingWithOrdinalWork with the nonnil unlimited metric vector supplied by ordinary zipper.applyPrimaryDirectory. That helper selects AddPendingWithWork, which requires WorkLease for every existing binding. Ordinary Lease requires only Resize and Close. The fixture is valid and its refusal flag is still false at the unexpected error.
findings.consequence: A previously supported ordinary publication returns ErrWorkRequired instead of reaching its original admission or visibility behavior. This is a production compatibility defect, not a fixture needing native capability.
findings.correction: Use explicit ordinary/native policy throughout shared allocation/construction/seal/promotion growth. Ordinary mode must retain original quota admission, Resize, rollback/refund and metrics; native mode must retain bounded WorkLease requirements and effect-free refusal. Do not globally fall back to unbounded Lease operations inside native work, drop admission, or merely add WorkLease to this fixture.

findings.title: Ordinary counted-work root construction inherits native no-rehash refusal
findings.trigger: The same ordinary nonnil metric-work constructor with the original read-root table at count >= 2*len(heads). Initial heads=256, so 512 live retained root entries reach this boundary.
findings.cause: The arena selects PrepareConstructedPrimaryReadRootOwnerWithWorkV6 solely because work is nonnil. That explicitly native finite route refuses before rehash. Ordinary PreparePrimaryReadRootOwnerV6 at lines68-90 instead admits new backing and rehashes the same table.
findings.consequence: An ordinary writer with enough held roots fails ErrWorkRequired even with sufficient quota and otherwise supported ordinary geometry. This remains after upgrading all enrolled leases to WorkLease.
findings.correction: Separate native finite table insertion from ordinary counted-work insertion. Preserve ordinary admitted growth and original table/custody ownership; preserve native effect-free refusal for unsupported rehash. Do not increase a guessed fixed table limit or allow unpriced rehash inside native admission.
